Having gone through it with our legal team, we are happy with the terms, with one exception: clause 9 states that either party may terminate the agreement with one month’s notice. Given the investment we will be making, we would rather the notice period were three months. Provided you can agree to this change, we will sign immediately.
Best regards,
Mairi

Dear Ms Campbell,

Kernow Logistics will handle all deliveries in the south-west for an initial period of two years, at a rate of 4.20 pounds per parcel. Should volumes exceed 10,000 parcels per month, this rate will be reduced to 3.90 pounds. Please find enclosed two copies of the contract. I would be grateful if you could sign both and return one to us by 30 June.
Yours sincerely,
Alistair Reid
